numbersSubtitle: Manage WhatsApp Business Cloud API numbers and credentials.

tokenTestReasonInvalidToken.__fn: reason=>`Meta rejected this token as invalid or expired: ${reason}. Generate a fresh System User token in Meta Business Settings and paste it here.`

tokenTestReasonMetaPermissions.__fn: reason=>`Meta rejected this token \u2014 missing permissions (${reason}). The token must belong to a System User with "Full control" (or at least partial access) on this number's WhatsApp Business Account and include the whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging permissions.`

tokenTestReasonMetaError.__fn: reason=>`Meta returned an error while validating the token: ${reason}. Note this came from Meta, not from this site's permissions.`

tokenTestReasonNotConnected.__fn: reason=>{const status=reason??"unknown";return`The token is valid, but Meta reports this number's status as "${status}" instead of "CONNECTED". Check the number in WhatsApp Manager \u2014 it may be unregistered, disconnected, or limited.`}

tokenTestReasonNetworkError.__fn: reason=>{const detail=reason?`: ${reason}`:"";return`Could not reach Meta to validate the token${detail}. Check the server's internet connectivity and try again.`}

tokenTestReasonRequestRejected.__fn: reason=>{const detail=reason?`: ${reason}`:"";return`The server rejected the test request itself${detail}. This is a permissions/validation issue on this site \u2014 not a problem with the Meta token.`}

localDeactivateAccountTooltip: The number stays on this system and on Meta, but the platform stops using it.
localDeactivateConfirm: Are you sure you want to stop using this WhatsApp number?

syncFromMetaUnavailable.__fn: missingEnvKeys=>`Sync from Meta is unavailable: missing WhatsApp configuration (${missingEnvKeys}). Set these values in the environment, or add a WhatsApp account below.`

syncSuccess: Successfully synced WhatsApp accounts from Meta.

syncSuccessWithCounts.__fn: (synced,added)=>{const syncedPhrase=synced===1?"1 number":`${synced} numbers`;if(added===0){return`Synced ${syncedPhrase} from Meta \u2014 all are already known here, nothing new was added.`}const addedPhrase=added===1?"1 new number was":`${added} new numbers were`;return`Synced ${syncedPhrase} from Meta \u2014 ${addedPhrase} added.`}
